tbesh_html:
1) to hold a feast, hold a festival, make pilgrimage, keep a pilgrim-feast, celebrate, dance, stagger
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to keep a pilgrim-feast
1a2) to reel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to move in acircle, i.e. (specifically) to march in asacred procession, to observe afestival; by implication, to be giddy
strongs_1890.kjv_def: celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro.
